user.title: JNS Deployment Platform
user.description:
Configure the JNS deployment transport. JNS will register this GitHub repository as a Home Assistant App repository, install JNS Secure SFTP, restrict it to SFTP-only access, and use it only to deliver signed deployment packages.

Last provisioning result: {provision_error}

data_description.sftp_password: Use a unique password of at least 24 characters. This is transport authentication only; JNS package signatures remain mandatory.

error.invalid_password: Use a password of at least 24 characters without line breaks.
error.cannot_provision_sftp: JNS Secure SFTP provisioning failed. The exact stage and Supervisor error are shown above.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one JNS Deployment Platform instance is supported.
abort.supervisor_required: JNS automatic SFTP bootstrap requires Home Assistant OS/Supervisor.
